{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert `revenue` from string to float: remove commas and cast
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_orders = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].sum()

total_revenue"}
